column_description: TEXT. Loan status of the artifact. PK. Possible values: Available, Not Available, On Loan.
REAL. Insurance value in USD for the artifact. Example: 968368.
TEXT. Security level for the artifact. Possible values: Level 1, Level 2, Level 3.
TEXT. Restrictions on access to the artifact. Possible values: Limited, Public, Restricted.
TEXT. Documentation status for the artifact. Possible values: Complete, Partial, Updating.
TEXT. Photo documentation status for the artifact. Possible values: Outdated, Recent, Required.
TEXT. Condition report status for the artifact. Possible values: Current, Due, Overdue.
TEXT. Conservation record for the artifact. Possible values: Pending, Review Required, Updated.
TEXT. Research access status for the artifact. Possible values: Available, Limited, Restricted.
TEXT. Digital record status for the artifact. Possible values: Complete, In Progress, Partial.
